results.title: LoupeKit: See what any page is built with and how much of it is AI
results.content:
1. A 0-100 score across five weighted categories — markup, CSS, runtime, copy, accessibility  
2. 66 heuristics, each finding saying exactly what it measured and what to change  
3. Click a finding and the page scrolls to that element and selects it — you look at the thing, not at a line number  
  
That third one is what I actually wanted. A number on its own is an opinion. A number that walks you to the element it is talking  
about is a review.  
  
The hard part was calibration, in the direction nobody expects: getting it to leave careful hand-written work alone. A tool that  
flags good code is worse than no tool — you stop reading it, and then it never catches the real thing either. [...] One decision I would defend loudest: no website permission at install. Empty host\_permissions in both builds. It reads the tab you  
are on, when you click, and nothing in the background.  
  
Free tier is 3 audits, everything else unlimited. Chrome, Edge, Firefox and others.  
  
Enjoy!  
— Jan [...] LoupeKit

results.title: LoupeKit — Web Tech & AI Vibe-Code Inspector
results.content:
LoupeKit is a developer's inspector for the page you already have open. It answers four questions, and it only ever looks at the tab you are on, when you ask it to. WHAT IS THIS BUILT WITH Detects 1700 technologies — frameworks, UI kits, icon systems, bundlers and module loaders, JavaScript libraries, CDNs, caches, web servers, load balancers, server-rendered frameworks, CMS and commerce platforms, payment processors, analytics, marketing and advertising tags, error tracking and session replay, live chat, consent banners, bot management, the form backend a contact form posts to, and the metadata a page declares about itself — and shows how each one was identified: a DOM marker, an asset URL, the generator meta tag, a page global, a namespaced CSS variable, or a header on the page's own [...] a namespaced CSS variable, or a header on the page's own response. Versions are read wherever the page states one. Open any row for what it is, what exactly matched, its confidence and a link to its documentation. Includes a client-side page pulse — DOM size and depth, scripts, stylesheets, images, third-party origins and paint timings — with the script, stylesheet, image and third-party lists opening in a sortable window of their own, plus a one-click Markdown report. HOW MUCH OF THIS IS VIBE-CODED An audit scores the page from 0 to 100 across five weighted categories: DOM and HTML artifacts, CSS and utility-class verbosity, JavaScript runtime artifacts, copywriting patterns, and accessibility.
